title: Prisma schema + 資料庫遷移 + seed 腳本
acceptance: Prisma schema defines all 6 models: User, Organization, Course, Instructor, Registrant, Admin
All enums: Role, RegistrationStatus, EnrollmentType, PaymentStatus, PaymentMethod, AdminPermission
npx prisma migrate dev runs successfully against local PostgreSQL
Seed script inserts 2 instructors + 2 courses + syllabus items + schedules + FAQs + reviews

verification: npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed && npx prisma studio
